title: C22 Capstone (INTEGRATIVE — runs LAST, alone)
acceptance_criteria: Nextmart is polished into a coherent deployable portfolio piece: the storefront product listing renders and is navigable and the seller dashboard surface is reachable, with consistent error / empty / loading states applied across the polished surfaces (QA functional: storefront product listing renders and is navigable; seller dashboard accessible).

A documented performance budget (docs/perf-budget.md) is defined with target metrics, and docs/a11y-pass.md records an accessibility pass (keyboard nav, alt text, contrast, landmarks) with findings addressed or noted.
README.md explains the project, the challenge harness, how to run it, and the rendering-strategy story; docs/deploy-notes.md gives concrete deploy instructions.
`next build`, `tsc --noEmit`, and `npm run lint` all still exit 0 after the capstone polish — no regression to the foundation (QA critical: repo builds / typecheck / lint).

The c22 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts. NOTE (sequencing): this task is the ONLY challenge permitted to edit the shared shell (app/layout.tsx, app/page.tsx, app/globals.css); it MUST run last and alone (after all other tasks) so those shared edits never collide with a parallel task.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
